title: Document the input schema of the three free tools in API-CONTRACT.md
problem: docs/API-CONTRACT.md lists the six tools and their prices but not their arguments. An agent that wants to call ailn_discover or ailn_inspect has to guess the parameter names, and guessing is exactly what a contract document exists to prevent.
deliverables: A parameter table for ailn_discover, ailn_inspect and ailn_quote
Each row copied from the live inputSchema, not paraphrased
acceptance: Every parameter name matches the live tools/list response
The examples are valid JSON and call the free tools only
No price or network claim is changed

required: the tools/list output you copied from
